entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number, please?
Thank you, Alex. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's just not what I wanted. There was a family emergency right after it arrived. I was at the hospital for over a week.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everyone is okay now. So just to confirm, there's nothing wrong with the device itself?
I wouldn't know. I had to have unexpected surgery. I haven't even opened it. I just want my money back.
I understand completely, and I'm so sorry you had to go through that. Let me just pull up our return policy to see what we can do. One moment please.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I see the item was delivered 21 days ago. I'm checking our knowledge base now... and yes, our policy states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that timeframe.

Absolutely. I've just authorized the full refund. I'm emailing a pre-paid return label to you right now. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. And since you're a VIP member and given the circumstances with the medical emergency, I've also added a $25 credit to your VeloFit account for any future purchase.
Whatever. About time something went right. Thanks, I guess.
You're most welcome, Alex. We appreciate your business. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope things get better for you soon.
